div.p: Thank you for interviewing with us. We are delighted to offer you the position of at , and feel that you will be an excellent addition to our team.
The terms and conditions of your employment are as follows:
Apart from the salary, we will also offer you the following benefits (which will be unlocked post probation):

ul.li: Health Insurance (OPD) – including spouse, kids & parents
Annual Leaves – (including leave encashment option on selected leaves)
Situational Leaves – (e.g., Maternity, Paternity, Wedding, Bereavement etc.)

div.p: We feel that you will be a great fit for our team, and look forward to having you here. Please confirm your acceptance of this understanding by replying to this email.

p.b: Please state your acceptance and mention your joining date.
NOTE: This offer is only valid for the next 48 hours.

ul.li: The probation review lets us communicate feedback on your performance and share our assessment of your work. Please do note that based on the probation review, your probation period may end or be extended, and subsequent employment is subject to satisfactory performance.
The salary amount mentioned in this email is gross, and is subject to applicable taxes as per local laws.
